# Test fixtures

Two small, self-contained Angular projects. They are never installed (`node_modules` is absent)
and ship a prebuilt `dist/` (generated by `scripts/gen-fixture-dist.py`) and a coverage report,
so audits are fast, offline (`"offline": true` in their configs) and deterministic.

## `healthy/` (exits 0)

Angular 22, standalone components, OnPush, signals, `@if`/`@for`, `inject()`,
`takeUntilDestroyed`, strict TypeScript + strict templates, ESLint/angular-eslint + Prettier,
a spec per unit, 92% coverage, a 83 kB initial bundle within budget, and an accessible `index.html`.
Every static check scores 100 with no findings.

## `unhealthy/` (exits 1)

Each issue is deliberate and asserted exactly in the unit tests and the integration snapshot:

| Area          | Known issue                                                                 | Check                          |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Dependencies  | Angular 17 (end-of-life)                                                     | `dependencies/angular-version` |
| Dependencies  | tslint, protractor (high), karma, moment (low)                               | `dependencies/deprecated`      |
| Bundle        | 190 kB initial vs 100 kB error budget; 2 scripts over `anyScript`; 300 kB lazy chunk | `bundle/size`          |
| Angular       | 2 components without OnPush                                                  | `angular/onpush`               |
| Angular       | method calls in both templates                                               | `angular/template-calls`       |
| Angular       | 2 `subscribe()` without cleanup (the `route.params` one is exempt)           | `angular/subscriptions`        |
| Angular       | `*ngIf`/`*ngFor`, `[ngSwitch]`                                               | `angular/control-flow`         |
| Angular       | NgModule-declared components                                                 | `angular/standalone`           |
| Angular       | constructor injection while 2 services use `inject()`                        | `angular/inject-function`      |
| Angular       | 6 explicit `any` in 3 files                                                  | `angular/any-usage`            |
| Angular       | `DashboardComponent` over the fixture's `maxLoc: 40`                         | `angular/large-components`     |
| Hygiene       | tslint.json but no ESLint; no Prettier                                       | `hygiene/tooling`              |
| Hygiene       | `strict: false`, no strict templates/injection parameters                    | `hygiene/typescript-strict`    |
| Hygiene       | 1 of 4 units has a spec                                                      | `hygiene/tests`                |
| Hygiene       | 30% line coverage (lcov)                                                     | `hygiene/coverage`             |
| Accessibility | missing lang/title/alt, unnamed button and link, low contrast               | `accessibility/axe`            |

## Changing a fixture

1. Edit the sources (or `scripts/gen-fixture-dist.py` for `dist/`, then run it).
2. Update the exact expectations in `test/unit/checks/*.test.ts`.
3. Review and update the integration snapshot: `npx vitest run test/integration -u`.
